basis_description: Two layer envelope fields, one selected spin-valley branch per layer; layer-major plane-wave basis with exp(i(k-Q).r). No independent spin index.
k_convention: hf_adapter uses fractional k_cartesian=k_fractional@reciprocal_basis(theta), B rows in inverse angstrom. Native AngleModel uses Cartesian k. Archived path fractional coordinates instead use source F=fractional_to_model(theta).
carrier_convention: Electron valence Hamiltonian, negative quadratic dispersion. Hole Hamiltonian Etop(Gamma) I - H_e(-k).T; Kprime=H_K(-k).conj(). No extra spin degeneracy.
hf_scope: Portable single-particle matrix only. Interactions, Coulomb form factors, filling and HF solver are not supplied or validated.
reference_type: Projected Heff energies and fixed layer/Q model-Heff wavefunction overlaps; not native TAPW wavefunction fidelity.
limitations: Only top3 fitted; bands4-6 plotted as context.
